schema.name: card_origins

schema.name: chat_merge_messages
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE chat_merge_messages ( merge_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_merges(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_slot_id TEXT, speaker_entity_id TEXT, speaker_name TEXT NOT NULL, side TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, sent_at INTEGER NOT NULL, included TEXT NOT NULL, -- The cards that knew this source message in the source (its version's knowers, -- spec/CHARACTER-CONTEXT.md §9.1); NULL for summaries and messages with no cast recorded. knowers_json TEXT CHECK (knowers_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(knowers_json) AND json_type(knowers_json) = 'array')), -- Soft: the version copied, beside source_slot_id (spec/THREADS.md §4.1). source_version_id TEXT, -- The copied version's image media ids; NULL when it had none. media_json TEXT CHECK (media_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(media_json) AND json_type(media_json) = 'array')), -- Where it was in the source, as zero-based display positions: a message's own, a summary's -- first and last (the agent's read tools name a joined row by it, spec/THREADS.md §11). source_from INTEGER, source_to INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (merge_id, ordinal) ) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: connections
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE connections ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, -- The provider chosen for it (providerDefinitions.ts), which sets its defaults, and the -- defaults the user changed: only the changes are stored. provider TEXT NOT NULL, provider_settings_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(provider_settings_json)), kind TEXT NOT NULL, api TEXT NOT NULL, -- NULL means the kind's default. base_url TEXT, -- Write-only secrets, encrypted with the server secret (PROVIDERS §5). Header values -- often carry credentials too, so only header names are ever shown. headers_enc BLOB, header_names_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(header_names_json)), compat_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(compat_json)), cache_ttl_s INTEGER CHECK (cache_ttl_s IS NULL OR cache_ttl_s > 0), max_concurrent INTEGER CHECK (max_concurrent IS NULL OR max_concurrent >= 1), -- The per-connection proxy override (PROVIDERS §6.2). proxy_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit' CHECK (proxy_mode IN ('inherit', 'direct', 'custom')), proxy_url_enc BLOB, preset_override_ref_id TEXT REFERENCES entity_refs(id), row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, deleted_at INTEGER, bin_item_id TEXT, -- Purged connections stay as tombstones, so old messages and ledger rows still -- name their model (PROVIDERS §10). purged_at INTEGER, credential_id TEXT REFERENCES credentials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, headers_origin TEXT, cache_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CHECK ((proxy_mode = 'custom') = (proxy_url_enc IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (purged_at IS NULL OR (headers_enc IS NULL AND proxy_url_enc IS NULL AND base_url IS NULL)) ) STRICT

schema.name: draft_history

schema.name: drafts
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE drafts ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), target_kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_id TEXT NOT NULL, field TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', content TEXT NOT NULL, images_json TEXT CHECK (images_json IS NULL OR json_valid(images_json)), -- Compressed edit history: survives a refresh and recovers from Ctrl-A plus a stray key. base_revision TEXT, -- A library field's session a save or checkpoint ended: the revision now holding its text. committed_revision TEXT, row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, cleared_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deletions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(deletions_json)), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, session INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, text_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, speaker_entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, reply_from_entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, guidance INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (guidance IN (0, 1)), -- The composer's Next set to No one: a send asks for no reply until another choice (DESIGN §2.3). no_replies INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (no_replies IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE (user_id, target_kind, target_id, field) ) STRICT

schema.name: fork_overrides
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE fork_overrides ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, fork_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- The chat's state_seq when written; a row updated in place takes the newer one. seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq > 0), kind TEXT NOT NULL, -- image_exclude: the message's own version and an image of it, "<version id>:<media id>". target_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- The slot the row is about, and its depth, for reading a window of a path. slot_id TEXT, slot_depth INTEGER, value_id TEXT, flag INTEGER CHECK (flag IS NULL OR flag IN (0, 1)), bin_item_id TEXT REFERENCES bin_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, changeset_id TEXT REFERENCES changesets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, summaries_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (summaries_done IN (0, 1)), -- Who chose it: the user, or an ST re-import following the file (which the user's choice -- then overrules: stImportWrites.ts). origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user' ) STRICT

schema.name: fork_summaries
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE fork_summaries ( fork_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES forks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- The computation's format, and the chat's and owner's stamps it was computed at. format INTEGER NOT NULL, stamp INTEGER NOT NULL, user_stamp INTEGER NOT NULL, preview TEXT NOT NULL, messages INTEGER NOT NULL, leaf TEXT, end_at INTEGER, -- Where it parts from the fork it was made from: its first own message's time (else its -- making) and how many messages it shares (forkSummaries.ts); null for a chat's first. split_at INTEGER, split_after INTEGER, -- Entity ids only: names and avatars are read with the summary. cast_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(cast_json)), joined_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(joined_json)), departed_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(departed_json)), activity_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(activity_json)), added_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(added_json)), -- The threads it's in (spec/THREADS.md §4.3): [split id, ordinal] pairs, innermost first. threads_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(threads_json) AND json_type(threads_json) = 'array') , preview_macro TEXT CHECK (preview_macro IS NULL OR json_valid(preview_macro))) STRICT

schema.name: forks
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE forks ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- The fork it was made from; null for a chat's first. Its place in the fork tree is in fork_labels. parent_fork_id TEXT REFERENCES forks(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, split_chat INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (split_chat IN (0, 1)), -- The picture of the chat split off at this fork (split_chat = 1); the original chat's is chats.cover_media_id. cover_media_id TEXT REFERENCES media_assets(id), -- The chat's state_seq when it was made. branched_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- The message it was made at: its history is root to base, then what it appends. base_slot_id TEXT REFERENCES slots(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, -- Its path ends here; null before the first message. tip_slot_id TEXT REFERENCES slots(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, name TEXT, name_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (name_user IN (0, 1)), pinned_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_chatted_at INTEGER, deleted_at INTEGER, bin_item_id TEXT REFERENCES bin_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, purged_at INTEGER, row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 ) STRICT

schema.name: llm_requests
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE llm_requests ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connections(id), model_id TEXT REFERENCES models(id), chat_id TEXT REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, rollout_id TEXT REFERENCES rollouts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, version_id TEXT REFERENCES versions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, purpose TEXT NOT NULL, -- What was requested. api TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL, model_key TEXT NOT NULL, -- What served it: the model the response named, and the routed upstream where a -- gateway reports one (OpenRouter). response_model TEXT, upstream TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER NOT NULL, first_token_at INTEGER, ended_at INTEGER, -- Normalized counts (PROVIDERS §9.2). cache_write_long is the subset of cache_write -- written with the long TTL; reasoning is the subset of output. estimated_input INTEGER, input_tokenizer TEXT, input_uncached INTEGER, cache_read INTEGER, cache_write INTEGER, cache_write_long INTEGER, output INTEGER, reasoning INTEGER, usage_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', -- The provider's usage object verbatim, so counts can be recomputed if a -- normalization turns out wrong. raw_usage_json TEXT CHECK (raw_usage_json IS NULL OR json_valid(raw_usage_json)), reported_cost REAL, cost REAL, cost_currency TEXT, -- What produced cost: a built-in price source, 'reported', or a user formula. cost_formula TEXT, -- The rates cost was priced with (per million tokens: input, read, write, writeLong, -- output), beside its formula: a later recalculation applies only to rows priced from a -- price table or the user's rules, never to a provider-reported charge, which has none. cost_rates_json TEXT CHECK (cost_rates_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(cost_rates_json) AND cost IS NOT NULL AND cost_formula IS NOT 'reported')), -- The network route the request took (direct and why, or the proxy by scheme, host and -- port), for the requests that went out. route_json TEXT CHECK (route_json IS NULL OR json_valid(route_json)), error_json TEXT CHECK (error_json IS NULL OR json_valid(error_json)), cache_stagger_json TEXT CHECK (cache_stagger_json IS NULL OR json_valid(cache_stagger_json)), cache_identity_json TEXT CHECK (cache_identity_json IS NULL OR json_valid(cache_identity_json)), backfill_id TEXT REFERENCES jobs(id), reserved_tokens INTEGER, reserved_cost REAL, reserved_currency TEXT, CHECK ((status = 'running') = (ended_at IS NULL)), CHECK ((cost IS NULL) = (cost_currency IS NULL) AND (cost IS NULL) = (cost_formula IS NULL)) ) STRICT

schema.name: mcp_calls
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE mcp_calls ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_connections(id), connection_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (connection_revision >= 0), method TEXT NOT NULL, tool TEXT CHECK (tool IS NULL OR length(tool) <= 128), purpose TEXT NOT NULL, chat_id TEXT REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, rollout_id TEXT REFERENCES rollouts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, tool_call_id TEXT, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (attempt >= 1), status TEXT NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER NOT NULL, ended_at INTEGER, sent_bytes INTEGER CHECK (sent_bytes IS NULL OR sent_bytes >= 0), received_bytes INTEGER CHECK (received_bytes IS NULL OR received_bytes >= 0), error TEXT CHECK (error IS NULL OR length(error) <= 1000), CHECK ((status = 'running') = (ended_at IS NULL)), CHECK ((method = 'tools/call') = (tool IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (method = 'tools/call' OR (rollout_id IS NULL AND tool_call_id IS NULL)) ) STRICT

schema.name: mcp_connection_shares
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE mcp_connection_shares ( connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_connections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (connection_id, user_id) ) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: mcp_connections
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE mcp_connections ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), -- The fixed part of the tools' names the model sees, mcp_<key>_<tool>. Never changes. key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(key) BETWEEN 1 AND 24 AND key GLOB '[a-z]*' AND key NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*'), -- The user's own words for what it's for: the skill index line. about TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(about) <= 1000), transport TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transport IN ('streamable-http', 'sse', 'stdio')), url TEXT CHECK (url IS NULL OR length(url) <= 2048), -- stdio: the argv array, no shell. command_json TEXT CHECK (command_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(command_json) AND json_type(command_json) = 'array')), env_enc BLOB, env_names_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(env_names_json) AND json_type(env_names_json) = 'array'), credential_id TEXT REFERENCES credentials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, headers_enc BLOB, header_names_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(header_names_json) AND json_type(header_names_json) = 'array'), headers_origin TEXT, proxy_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit' CHECK (proxy_mode IN ('inherit', 'direct', 'custom')), proxy_url_enc BLOB, timeout_s INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60 CHECK (timeout_s BETWEEN 5 AND 1800), loading TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' CHECK (loading IN ('auto', 'immediate', 'deferred')), use_instructions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (use_instructions IN (0, 1)), share_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private' CHECK (share_scope IN ('private', 'all', 'chosen')), -- The last listing (§4.1): server info and the tool catalog, with its revision. server_json TEXT CHECK (server_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(server_json) AND json_type(server_json) = 'object')), tools_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(tools_json) AND json_type(tools_json) = 'array'), catalog_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (catalog_revision >= 0), listed_at INTEGER, check_error TEXT CHECK (check_error IS NULL OR length(check_error) <= 1000), row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (row_version >= 1), -- Advances on any change to where or how calls are sent; open clients close on it. cache_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cache_revision >= 0), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, deleted_at INTEGER, bin_item_id TEXT, -- Purged connections stay as tombstones, so the call ledger still names them. purged_at INTEGER, CHECK (purged_at IS NOT NULL OR ((transport = 'stdio') = (command_json IS NOT NULL) AND (transport = 'stdio') = (url IS NULL))), CHECK (transport = 'stdio' OR (env_enc IS NULL AND env_names_json = '[]')), CHECK (transport <> 'stdio' OR (credential_id IS NULL AND headers_enc IS NULL AND proxy_mode = 'inherit')), CHECK ((proxy_mode = 'custom') = (proxy_url_enc IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (purged_at IS NULL OR (url IS NULL AND command_json IS NULL AND env_enc IS NULL AND credential_id IS NULL AND headers_enc IS NULL AND proxy_url_enc IS NULL)) ) STRICT

schema.name: mcp_uses
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE mcp_uses ( connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_connections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, stories INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stories IN (0, 1)), workshops INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (workshops IN (0, 1)), -- { "<MCP tool name>": { "on": bool } }: the allow list; annotations are never stored here. tools_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(tools_json) AND json_type(tools_json) = 'object'), reviewed_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reviewed_revision >= 0), offered_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(offered_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 26 AND offered_key NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*'), -- This user's own sign-in with the server (§2.4), bound to "mcp:<connection>:<user>:oauth". oauth_enc BLOB, oauth_origin TEXT, oauth_expires_at INTEGER, row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (row_version >= 1), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK ((oauth_enc IS NULL) = (oauth_origin IS NULL)), CHECK (oauth_expires_at IS NULL OR oauth_enc IS NOT NULL), PRIMARY KEY (connection_id, user_id) ) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: models

schema.name: queued_messages
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE queued_messages ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- The reply it waits for: the slot, not a version, so it posts after whichever version -- ends up selected. reply_slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES slots(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Order among the entries waiting in a chat. seq INTEGER NOT NULL, -- A message to post, or a reply to generate. kind TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, -- As on versions: the typed text before regex scripts rewrote it, and what they did. raw_content TEXT, rewrite_json TEXT CHECK (rewrite_json IS NULL OR json_valid(rewrite_json)), speaker_entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- For 'message': who replies to it once it posts, picked when it was sent, as an -- immediate send's reply is. reply_speaker_entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- For 'generate': the one-turn direction the reply gets. direction TEXT, row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, no_reply INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (no_reply IN (0, 1)), fork_id TEXT, images_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(images_json)), -- 1: a reply of a round (DESIGN §2.3), queued by the server behind the round's reply before it. round INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (round IN (0, 1)), -- 1: its round stopped (Stop, a failed reply, a restart) and waits for Continue round. held INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (held IN (0, 1)), -- 1: its reply's speaker is for the decision model to choose when it posts (Auto's pick if it can't). auto_pick INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (auto_pick IN (0, 1)), -- A copy of a message sent to several threads that queued behind a reply: its group, so -- the post writes its thread_sends row (spec/THREADS.md §6.2). send_group TEXT, -- A round's entry: the slot of the round's first reply, once there is one, so the turns -- already decided can be shown (DESIGN §2.3). round_start_slot_id TEXT REFERENCES slots(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CHECK (round = 0 OR kind = 'generate'), CHECK (held = 0 OR round = 1), CHECK (kind = 'generate' OR length(content) > 0 OR json_array_length(images_json) > 0), CHECK (kind = 'generate' OR direction IS NULL), CHECK (kind = 'message' OR reply_speaker_entity_id IS NULL) ) STRICT

schema.name: rollout_effects
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE rollout_effects ( rollout_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rollouts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, tool_call_id TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq >= 0), kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, undo_json TEXT CHECK (undo_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(undo_json) AND json_type(undo_json) = 'object')), undo_result_json TEXT CHECK (undo_result_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(undo_result_json) AND json_type(undo_result_json) = 'object')), undone_at INTEGER CHECK (undone_at IS NULL OR undone_at >= created_at), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK ((undone_at IS NULL) = (undo_result_json IS NULL)), PRIMARY KEY (rollout_id, tool_call_id, seq), FOREIGN KEY (rollout_id, tool_call_id) REFERENCES rollout_receipts(rollout_id, tool_call_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: rollouts
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE rollouts ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, kind TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, slot_id TEXT REFERENCES slots(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, leaf_slot_id TEXT REFERENCES slots(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, parent_rollout_id TEXT REFERENCES rollouts(id), role TEXT NOT NULL, connection_id TEXT REFERENCES connections(id), model_id TEXT REFERENCES models(id), request_class TEXT NOT NULL, -- Provider-reported usage, rolled up. NULL means unknown, not zero (as in reference-harness). llm_requests INTEGER, usage_input_tokens INTEGER, usage_output_tokens INTEGER, usage_cache_read_tokens INTEGER, usage_cache_write_tokens INTEGER, usage_cost REAL, cache_observed_json TEXT CHECK (cache_observed_json IS NULL OR json_valid(cache_observed_json)), error TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at INTEGER , context_issues_json TEXT CHECK (context_issues_json IS NULL OR json_valid(context_issues_json)), history_start_slot_id TEXT, history_start_depth INTEGER, history_depth INTEGER, fork_id TEXT, -- Agent rollouts (spec/AGENTIC.md §9): tool calls so far, and the orchestration mode it ran in. step_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (step_count >= 0), mode TEXT, spawned_by_rollout_id TEXT REFERENCES rollouts(id), spawned_by_call_id TEXT, agent_handle TEXT CHECK (agent_handle IS NULL OR length(agent_handle) BETWEEN 1 AND 64), contract_outcome TEXT CHECK (contract_outcome IS NULL OR contract_outcome IN ('clean', 'recovered', 'gave_up', 'exhausted', 'stopped', 'failed', 'capped')), contract_nudges INTEGER CHECK (contract_nudges IS NULL OR contract_nudges >= 0)) STRICT

schema.name: st_import_jobs

schema.name: st_import_stage

schema.name: state_events
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_events ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, slot_id TEXT REFERENCES slots(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, version_id TEXT REFERENCES versions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT, value_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(value_json)), origin TEXT NOT NULL, origin_ref TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, superseded_by_changeset TEXT REFERENCES changesets(id), slot_chain_id TEXT, slot_depth INTEGER, fork_id TEXT REFERENCES forks(id), fork_seq INTEGER, -- Its fork's point when written (db/forkLabels.ts): visible where label <= point < the fork's end. fork_label BLOB, CHECK ((fork_id IS NULL AND fork_seq IS NULL) OR (fork_id IS NOT NULL AND fork_seq IS NOT NULL AND fork_seq > 0)), CHECK (key <> 'card.swap' OR (slot_id IS NULL AND version_id IS NULL AND scope IS NULL AND fork_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (version_id IS NULL OR slot_id IS NOT NULL) ) STRICT

schema.name: summaries
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE summaries ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (level >= 1), selected_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES summary_revisions(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, first_slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES slots(id), last_slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES slots(id), slot_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (slot_count >= 1), -- NULL: a summary of the whole path (shared context, narrators). Otherwise the sorted card ids -- whose separate view it summarizes: who held exactly its inputs over its range -- (spec/CHARACTER-CONTEXT.md §9.1). audience_json TEXT CHECK (audience_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(audience_json) AND json_type(audience_json) = 'array')), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'complete', sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (sealed IN (0, 1)), error_json TEXT CHECK (error_json IS NULL OR json_valid(error_json)), batch_id TEXT, rollout_id TEXT REFERENCES rollouts(id), row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, -- The images a level-1 summary was written with (db/lcmImages.ts): {"limit": N|null, "sent": [media ids], "withheld": [media ids]}. -- NULL when its inputs' versions had no images, so freshness needs no image read. images_json TEXT CHECK (images_json IS NULL OR json_valid(images_json)) ) STRICT

schema.name: summarization_jobs
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE summarization_jobs ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fork_id TEXT REFERENCES forks(id), chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (level >= 1), first_slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES slots(id), last_slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES slots(id), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', request_class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'background', batch_id TEXT, leaf_slot_id TEXT REFERENCES slots(id), input_token_count INTEGER, target_token_count INTEGER NOT NULL, -- Level >= 2: the ordered child summary ids (JSON array). input_child_ids TEXT CHECK (input_child_ids IS NULL OR json_valid(input_child_ids)), absorbed_parent_id TEXT REFERENCES summaries(id), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, max_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, best_effort_draft TEXT, error TEXT, result_summary_id TEXT REFERENCES summaries(id), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL , clip_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 6000 CHECK (clip_tokens > 0), claim_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rollout_id TEXT REFERENCES rollouts(id), prefix_json TEXT CHECK (prefix_json IS NULL OR json_valid(prefix_json)), model_json TEXT CHECK (model_json IS NULL OR json_valid(model_json)), fallback_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fallback_used IN (0, 1)), eager INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (eager IN (0, 1)), source_summary_id TEXT REFERENCES summaries(id), source_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES summary_revisions(id), rerun_ids_json TEXT CHECK (rerun_ids_json IS NULL OR json_valid(rerun_ids_json)), explicit_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (explicit_requested IN (0, 1)), -- The view the job summarizes, as summaries.audience_json: NULL for the whole path. audience_json TEXT CHECK (audience_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(audience_json) AND json_type(audience_json) = 'array'))) STRICT

schema.name: version_texts

schema.name: versions

Fork deletion -- retains tombstones; chat deletion removes both versions and forks in one transaction. authoring_fork_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forks(id) ON DELETE NO ACTION DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED ) STRICT

schema.name: fork_labels_made
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_labels_made AFTER INSERT ON forks WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fork_label_pause) BEGIN INSERT INTO fork_labels (fork_id, chat_id, base, epoch, point, label_end) SELECT NEW.id, NEW.chat_id, b, 0, unhex(hex(b) || (CASE WHEN 0 < 224 THEN printf('%02X', 0 + 1) WHEN 0 < 65760 THEN 'F0' || printf('%04X', 0 - 224) ELSE 'F1' || printf('%016X', 0 - 224) END)), unhex(hex(b) || 'FF') FROM (SELECT coalesce((SELECT point FROM fork_labels WHERE fork_id = NEW.parent_fork_id), x'') AS b); UPDATE fork_labels SET epoch = epoch + 1, point = unhex(hex(base) || (CASE WHEN epoch + 1 < 224 THEN printf('%02X', epoch + 1 + 1) WHEN epoch + 1 < 65760 THEN 'F0' || printf('%04X', epoch + 1 - 224) ELSE 'F1' || printf('%016X', epoch + 1 - 224) END)) WHERE fork_id = NEW.parent_fork_id; END

schema.name: fork_overrides_delete_version_own

schema.name: fork_overrides_flag_set

schema.name: fork_overrides_insert

schema.name: fork_overrides_insert_update

schema.name: fork_overrides_move
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_move BEFORE INSERT ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'move' AND (NEW.flag IS NULL OR NEW.bin_item_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.changeset_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.slot_id IS NOT NEW.target_id OR NEW.slot_depth IS NOT (SELECT depth FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.target_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM slots x WHERE x.id = NEW.target_id AND x.chat_id = NEW.chat_id) OR (NEW.value_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM slots a WHERE a.id = NEW.value_id AND a.chat_id = NEW.chat_id)) OR (NEW.flag = 0 AND NEW.value_id IS NOT NULL)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a move shows a slot of its chat after one of its slots, at its own place, or leaves it out'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_move_update

schema.name: fork_overrides_presence_away

schema.name: fork_overrides_presence_range_0
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_presence_range_0 BEFORE INSERT ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'presence_range' AND ( NEW.flag IS NULL OR NEW.flag NOT IN (0,1) OR NEW.slot_id IS NULL OR NEW.value_id IS NULL OR NOT json_valid(NEW.value_id) OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.away') NOT IN ('true','false') OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.away') IS NULL OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.cutoff') IS NOT 'integer' OR NEW.value_id ->> '$.cutoff' < 0 OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.identities') IS NOT 'array' OR json_array_length(NEW.value_id, '$.identities') = 0 OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.spans') IS NOT 'array' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.value_id, '$.identities') c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM entities e JOIN chats chat ON chat.owner_user_id=e.owner_user_id WHERE e.id=c.value AND e.kind='card' AND chat.id=NEW.chat_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.value_id, '$.spans') span WHERE json_type(span.value, '$.lo') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_type(span.value, '$.hi') IS NOT 'integer' OR span.value ->> '$.lo' < 0 OR span.value ->> '$.hi' < span.value ->> '$.lo' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM slots s WHERE s.chat_id=NEW.chat_id AND s.chain_id=span.value ->> '$.chain'))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a presence range names its chat''s cards and chain intervals'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_presence_range_1
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_presence_range_1 BEFORE UPDATE OF value_id, flag ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'presence_range' AND ( NEW.flag IS NULL OR NEW.flag NOT IN (0,1) OR NEW.slot_id IS NULL OR NEW.value_id IS NULL OR NOT json_valid(NEW.value_id) OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.away') NOT IN ('true','false') OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.away') IS NULL OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.cutoff') IS NOT 'integer' OR NEW.value_id ->> '$.cutoff' < 0 OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.identities') IS NOT 'array' OR json_array_length(NEW.value_id, '$.identities') = 0 OR json_type(NEW.value_id, '$.spans') IS NOT 'array' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.value_id, '$.identities') c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM entities e JOIN chats chat ON chat.owner_user_id=e.owner_user_id WHERE e.id=c.value AND e.kind='card' AND chat.id=NEW.chat_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.value_id, '$.spans') span WHERE json_type(span.value, '$.lo') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_type(span.value, '$.hi') IS NOT 'integer' OR span.value ->> '$.lo' < 0 OR span.value ->> '$.hi' < span.value ->> '$.lo' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM slots s WHERE s.chat_id=NEW.chat_id AND s.chain_id=span.value ->> '$.chain'))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a presence range names its chat''s cards and chain intervals'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_steps
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_steps AFTER INSERT ON fork_overrides WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fork_label_pause) BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO fork_steps (kind, target_id, label, override_id) SELECT NEW.kind, NEW.target_id, l.label_end, (SELECT p.override_id FROM fork_steps p WHERE p.kind = NEW.kind AND p.target_id = NEW.target_id AND p.label <= l.label_end ORDER BY p.label DESC LIMIT 1) FROM fork_labels l WHERE l.fork_id = NEW.fork_id; INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fork_steps (kind, target_id, label, override_id) SELECT NEW.kind, NEW.target_id, l.point, NEW.id FROM fork_labels l WHERE l.fork_id = NEW.fork_id; END

SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'library recipe must name its target ref and row version') WHERE NEW.kind IN ('library.create', 'library.revise') AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_refs f WHERE f.id = json_extract(NEW.undo_json, '$.refId') AND f.entity_id = NEW.target_id) OR json_type(NEW.undo_json, '$.rowVersion') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_extract(NEW.undo_json, '$.rowVersion') < 0 ); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'revision recipe must retain its previous row version') WHERE NEW.kind = 'library.revise' AND ( json_type(NEW.undo_json, '$.beforeRowVersion') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_extract(NEW.undo_json, '$.beforeRowVersion') < 0 ); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'chat creation recipe must retain its state stamp') WHERE NEW.kind = 'chat.create' AND json_type(NEW.undo_json, '$.stamp') IS NOT 'text'; SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'creation recipe must name target ref and revision') WHERE NEW.kind = 'library.create' AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_refs f WHERE f.id = json_extract(NEW.undo_json, '$.refId') AND f.entity_id = NEW.target_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_revisions v WHERE v.id = json_extract(NEW.undo_json, '$.head') AND v.entity_id = NEW.target_id) ); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'revision recipe must name target revisions') WHERE NEW.kind = 'library.revise' AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_revisions v WHERE v.id = json_extract(NEW.undo_json, '$.before') AND v.entity_id = NEW.target_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_revisions v WHERE v.id = json_extract(NEW.undo_json, '$.head') AND v.entity_id = NEW.target_id) ); END

schema.name: summaries_chain
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summaries_chain BEFORE INSERT ON summaries WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lcm_enable_runs r WHERE r.id = NEW.id AND r.chat_id = NEW.chat_id AND r.phase = 'copy' AND r.gathered = NEW.slot_count AND json_extract(r.payload_json, '$.imported.firstSlotId') = NEW.first_slot_id AND json_extract(r.payload_json, '$.imported.lastSlotId') = NEW.last_slot_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, parent_slot_id, n) AS ( SELECT id, parent_slot_id, 1 FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.last_slot_id AND chat_id = NEW.chat_id UNION ALL SELECT s.id, s.parent_slot_id, c.n + 1 FROM slots s JOIN chain c ON s.id = c.parent_slot_id WHERE c.n < NEW.slot_count AND s.chat_id = NEW.chat_id ) SELECT 1 FROM chain WHERE id = NEW.first_slot_id AND n = NEW.slot_count ) AND NOT EXISTS ( -- A display range may leave an inserted subtree for an older inserted sibling or -- the ordinary successor of its anchor. It never returns from an ordinary branch. WITH RECURSIVE head(id, parent_slot_id, inserted, depth) AS ( SELECT id, parent_slot_id, inserted, depth FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.first_slot_id UNION ALL SELECT s.id, s.parent_slot_id, s.inserted, s.depth FROM slots s JOIN head h ON s.id = h.parent_slot_id WHERE h.inserted = 1 ), tail(id, parent_slot_id, inserted, depth) AS ( SELECT id, parent_slot_id, inserted, depth FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.last_slot_id UNION ALL SELECT s.id, s.parent_slot_id, s.inserted, s.depth FROM slots s JOIN tail t ON s.id = t.parent_slot_id WHERE t.depth > (SELECT min(depth) FROM head) ) SELECT 1 FROM head h JOIN tail t ON h.parent_slot_id IS t.parent_slot_id OR h.id = t.id WHERE NEW.slot_count >= 2 AND ( (h.id = NEW.first_slot_id AND h.id = t.id AND NEW.slot_count > (SELECT depth FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.last_slot_id) - h.depth + 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tail a JOIN slots x ON x.parent_slot_id = a.id WHERE x.inserted = 1 AND a.depth >= h.depth AND a.id <> NEW.last_slot_id)) OR (h.inserted = 1 AND h.id <> t.id AND (t.inserted = 0 OR h.id > t.id))) ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'summary endpoints must form its declared primary-parent chain'); END

schema.name: summary_inputs_chain
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summary_inputs_chain BEFORE INSERT ON summary_inputs WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM summaries s JOIN slots i ON i.id = NEW.slot_id WHERE s.id = NEW.summary_id AND s.level = 1 AND NEW.ordinal >= 0 AND NEW.ordinal < s.slot_count AND NEW.ordinal = coalesce((SELECT ordinal + 1 FROM summary_inputs WHERE summary_id = s.id ORDER BY ordinal DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AND CASE WHEN NEW.ordinal = 0 THEN NEW.slot_id = s.first_slot_id WHEN i.parent_slot_id = (SELECT slot_id FROM summary_inputs WHERE summary_id = s.id AND ordinal = NEW.ordinal - 1) THEN 1 ELSE EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE up(id, parent_slot_id, inserted, depth) AS ( SELECT id, parent_slot_id, inserted, depth FROM slots WHERE id = (SELECT slot_id FROM summary_inputs WHERE summary_id = NEW.summary_id AND ordinal = NEW.ordinal - 1) UNION ALL SELECT a.id, a.parent_slot_id, a.inserted, a.depth FROM slots a JOIN up ON a.id = up.parent_slot_id WHERE up.inserted = 1 AND up.depth > (SELECT depth FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id) ) SELECT 1 FROM up WHERE up.inserted = 1 AND up.id <> NEW.slot_id AND up.parent_slot_id IS i.parent_slot_id AND (i.inserted = 0 OR up.id > i.id)) END ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'summary inputs must follow their declared chain in order'); END

schema.name: summary_parents_chain
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summary_parents_chain BEFORE INSERT ON summary_parents WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM summaries s JOIN summaries child ON child.id = NEW.parent_id JOIN slots first ON first.id = child.first_slot_id WHERE s.id = NEW.summary_id AND s.level > 1 AND child.level < s.level AND child.id <> s.id AND child.sealed = 1 AND child.status <> 'failed' AND NEW.ordinal >= 0 AND NEW.ordinal = (SELECT count(*) FROM summary_parents WHERE summary_id = s.id) AND CASE WHEN NEW.ordinal = 0 THEN child.first_slot_id = s.first_slot_id WHEN first.parent_slot_id = (SELECT prev.last_slot_id FROM summary_parents p JOIN summaries prev ON prev.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.summary_id = s.id AND p.ordinal = NEW.ordinal - 1) THEN 1 ELSE EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE up(id, parent_slot_id, inserted, depth) AS ( SELECT id, parent_slot_id, inserted, depth FROM slots WHERE id = (SELECT prev.last_slot_id FROM summary_parents p JOIN summaries prev ON prev.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.summary_id = NEW.summary_id AND p.ordinal = NEW.ordinal - 1) UNION ALL SELECT a.id, a.parent_slot_id, a.inserted, a.depth FROM slots a JOIN up ON a.id = up.parent_slot_id WHERE up.inserted = 1 AND up.depth > (SELECT depth FROM slots WHERE id = child.first_slot_id) ) SELECT 1 FROM up WHERE up.inserted = 1 AND up.id <> child.first_slot_id AND up.parent_slot_id IS first.parent_slot_id AND (first.inserted = 0 OR up.id > first.id)) END ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'summary children must partition its chain at strictly lower levels'); END

schema.name: thread_members_fork

schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_participants_insert AFTER INSERT ON versions BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO version_participants(version_id, entity_id, version_seq) SELECT NEW.id, NEW.speaker_entity_id, NEW.seq WHERE NEW.speaker_entity_id IS NOT NULL; END

schema.name: version_participants_speaker
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_participants_speaker AFTER UPDATE OF speaker_entity_id ON versions WHEN NEW.speaker_entity_id IS NOT OLD.speaker_entity_id BEGIN DELETE FROM version_participants WHERE version_id = NEW.id; INSERT OR IGNORE INTO version_participants(version_id, entity_id, version_seq) SELECT NEW.id, c.value, NEW.seq FROM version_texts t, json_each(t.cast_json) c WHERE t.version_seq = NEW.seq AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(t.presence_json, '$.away') a WHERE a.value = c.value) UNION SELECT NEW.id, NEW.speaker_entity_id, NEW.seq WHERE NEW.speaker_entity_id IS NOT NULL; END

schema.name: version_records_insert
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_records_insert INSTEAD OF INSERT ON version_records BEGIN INSERT INTO versions (seq, id, slot_id, ordinal, status, speaker_entity_id, speaker_pick_json, writer, macro_mode, origin, source_version_id, rollout_id, connection_id, model_id, starred, hidden, changeset_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, bin_item_id, purged_at, mark, fork_id, authoring_fork_id) VALUES ( NEW.seq, NEW.id, NEW.slot_id, NEW.ordinal, NEW.status, NEW.speaker_entity_id, NEW.speaker_pick_json, NEW.writer, NEW.macro_mode, NEW.origin, NEW.source_version_id, NEW.rollout_id, NEW.connection_id, NEW.model_id, coalesce(NEW.starred, 0), coalesce(NEW.hidden, 0), NEW.changeset_id, NEW.created_at, NEW.updated_at, NEW.deleted_at, NEW.bin_item_id, NEW.purged_at, NEW.mark, NEW.fork_id, NEW.authoring_fork_id); INSERT INTO version_texts(version_seq, cast_json, presence_json, content, context_form, display_form, reasoning, raw_content, raw_reasoning, raw_sections, rewrite_json, reply_sections, frozen_macros, greeting_ref, direction, error_json, usage_json, recorded_model_json, recorded_generation_json) VALUES ( (SELECT seq FROM versions WHERE id = NEW.id), NEW.cast_json, NEW.presence_json, coalesce(NEW.content, ''), NEW.context_form, NEW.display_form, NEW.reasoning, NEW.raw_content, NEW.raw_reasoning, NEW.raw_sections, NEW.rewrite_json, NEW.reply_sections, NEW.frozen_macros, NEW.greeting_ref, NEW.direction, NEW.error_json, NEW.usage_json, NEW.recorded_model_json, NEW.recorded_generation_json); END

schema.name: version_records_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_records_update INSTEAD OF UPDATE ON version_records BEGIN -- History uses the amendment's timestamp; the purge guard needs its bin authorization. UPDATE versions SET updated_at = NEW.updated_at, purged_at = NEW.purged_at, bin_item_id = NEW.bin_item_id WHERE seq = OLD.seq AND (updated_at IS NOT NEW.updated_at OR purged_at IS NOT NEW.purged_at OR bin_item_id IS NOT NEW.bin_item_id); UPDATE version_texts SET cast_json = NEW.cast_json, presence_json = NEW.presence_json, content = NEW.content, context_form = NEW.context_form, display_form = NEW.display_form, reasoning = NEW.reasoning, raw_content = NEW.raw_content, raw_reasoning = NEW.raw_reasoning, raw_sections = NEW.raw_sections, rewrite_json = NEW.rewrite_json, reply_sections = NEW.reply_sections, frozen_macros = NEW.frozen_macros, greeting_ref = NEW.greeting_ref, direction = NEW.direction, error_json = NEW.error_json, usage_json = NEW.usage_json, recorded_model_json = NEW.recorded_model_json, recorded_generation_json = NEW.recorded_generation_json WHERE version_seq = OLD.seq AND (cast_json IS NOT NEW.cast_json OR presence_json IS NOT NEW.presence_json OR content IS NOT NEW.content OR context_form IS NOT NEW.context_form OR display_form IS NOT NEW.display_form OR reasoning IS NOT NEW.reasoning OR raw_content IS NOT NEW.raw_content OR raw_reasoning IS NOT NEW.raw_reasoning OR raw_sections IS NOT NEW.raw_sections OR rewrite_json IS NOT NEW.rewrite_json OR reply_sections IS NOT NEW.reply_sections OR frozen_macros IS NOT NEW.frozen_macros OR greeting_ref IS NOT NEW.greeting_ref OR direction IS NOT NEW.direction OR error_json IS NOT NEW.error_json OR usage_json IS NOT NEW.usage_json OR recorded_model_json IS NOT NEW.recorded_model_json OR recorded_generation_json IS NOT NEW.recorded_generation_json); -- Finalize only after saving text, while the old generating status still permits writes. UPDATE versions SET seq = NEW.seq, id = NEW.id, slot_id = NEW.slot_id, ordinal = NEW.ordinal, status = NEW.status, speaker_entity_id = NEW.speaker_entity_id, speaker_pick_json = NEW.speaker_pick_json, writer = NEW.writer, macro_mode = NEW.macro_mode, origin = NEW.origin, source_version_id = NEW.source_version_id, rollout_id = NEW.rollout_id, connection_id = NEW.connection_id, model_id = NEW.model_id, starred = NEW.starred, hidden = NEW.hidden, changeset_id = NEW.changeset_id, created_at = NEW.created_at, deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at, bin_item_id = NEW.bin_item_id, mark = NEW.mark, fork_id = NEW.fork_id, authoring_fork_id = NEW.authoring_fork_id WHERE seq = OLD.seq AND (seq IS NOT NEW.seq OR id IS NOT NEW.id OR slot_id IS NOT NEW.slot_id OR ordinal IS NOT NEW.ordinal OR status IS NOT NEW.status OR speaker_entity_id IS NOT NEW.speaker_entity_id OR speaker_pick_json IS NOT NEW.speaker_pick_json OR writer IS NOT NEW.writer OR macro_mode IS NOT NEW.macro_mode OR origin IS NOT NEW.origin OR source_version_id IS NOT NEW.source_version_id OR rollout_id IS NOT NEW.rollout_id OR connection_id IS NOT NEW.connection_id OR model_id IS NOT NEW.model_id OR starred IS NOT NEW.starred OR hidden IS NOT NEW.hidden OR changeset_id IS NOT NEW.changeset_id OR created_at IS NOT NEW.created_at OR deleted_at IS NOT NEW.deleted_at OR bin_item_id IS NOT NEW.bin_item_id OR mark IS NOT NEW.mark OR fork_id IS NOT NEW.fork_id OR authoring_fork_id IS NOT NEW.authoring_fork_id); END

schema.name: version_texts_failed_error
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_texts_failed_error BEFORE UPDATE OF error_json ON version_texts WHEN NEW.error_json IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM versions WHERE seq = OLD.version_seq AND status = 'failed' AND purged_at IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'failed versions require an error payload'); END

schema.name: version_texts_failed_error_insert
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_texts_failed_error_insert BEFORE INSERT ON version_texts WHEN NEW.error_json IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM versions WHERE seq = NEW.version_seq AND status = 'failed' AND purged_at IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'failed versions require an error payload'); END

schema.name: version_texts_identity_fixed
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_texts_identity_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF version_seq ON version_texts WHEN NEW.version_seq IS NOT OLD.version_seq BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version payload never changes owner'); END

schema.name: version_texts_length_insert
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_texts_length_insert AFTER INSERT ON version_texts WHEN (SELECT content_length FROM versions WHERE seq = NEW.version_seq) IS NOT length(NEW.content) BEGIN UPDATE versions SET content_length = length(NEW.content) WHERE seq = NEW.version_seq; END

schema.name: version_texts_length_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_texts_length_update AFTER UPDATE OF content ON version_texts WHEN NEW.content IS NOT OLD.content BEGIN UPDATE versions SET content_length = length(NEW.content) WHERE seq = NEW.version_seq; END

schema.name: version_texts_retained
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER version_texts_retained BEFORE DELETE ON version_texts WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM versions WHERE seq = OLD.version_seq) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'delete the version to delete its payload'); END

schema.name: versions_amend_history
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_amend_history AFTER UPDATE OF content ON version_texts WHEN NEW.content IS NOT OLD.content AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM versions WHERE seq = OLD.version_seq AND writer = 'human' AND status <> 'generating') BEGIN INSERT INTO version_history(version_id, content, replaced_at, images_json, reasoning_json, sections_json) SELECT v.id, OLD.content, v.updated_at, (SELECT json_group_array(json(CASE WHEN a.path IS NULL AND a.kind <> 'file' THEN json_object('mediaId', a.media_id, 'altText', coalesce(a.alt_text, '')) ELSE json_patch(json_object('mediaId', a.media_id, 'altText', coalesce(a.alt_text, '')), json_object('kind', CASE WHEN a.kind = 'file' THEN 'file' END, 'name', a.name, 'path', a.path)) END)) FROM (SELECT media_id, alt_text, kind, name, path FROM version_attachments WHERE version_id = v.id ORDER BY ordinal) a), json_quote(OLD.reasoning), OLD.reply_sections FROM versions v WHERE v.seq = OLD.version_seq; END

schema.name: versions_authoring_fork_chat
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_authoring_fork_chat BEFORE INSERT ON versions WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM slots s JOIN forks f ON f.id = NEW.authoring_fork_id WHERE s.id = NEW.slot_id AND s.chat_id <> f.chat_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version was written in a fork of its chat'); END

schema.name: versions_authoring_fork_chat_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_authoring_fork_chat_update BEFORE UPDATE OF slot_id ON versions WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM slots s JOIN forks f ON f.id = NEW.authoring_fork_id WHERE s.id = NEW.slot_id AND s.chat_id <> f.chat_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version was written in a fork of its chat'); END

schema.name: versions_authoring_fork_fixed
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_authoring_fork_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF authoring_fork_id ON versions WHEN NEW.authoring_fork_id IS NOT OLD.authoring_fork_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version keeps its authoring fork'); END

schema.name: versions_changeset_id_same_chat
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_changeset_id_same_chat BEFORE INSERT ON versions WHEN NEW.changeset_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT chat_id FROM changesets WHERE id = NEW.changeset_id) IS NOT (SELECT chat_id FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.changeset_id must be in the same chat'); END

schema.name: versions_changeset_id_same_chat_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_changeset_id_same_chat_update BEFORE UPDATE OF changeset_id, slot_id ON versions WHEN NEW.changeset_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT chat_id FROM changesets WHERE id = NEW.changeset_id) IS NOT (SELECT chat_id FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.changeset_id must be in the same chat'); END

schema.name: versions_deletion_per_fork
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_deletion_per_fork BEFORE UPDATE OF deleted_at ON versions WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bin_items b WHERE b.id = NEW.bin_item_id AND b.origin_json ->> '$.forkId' IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version is deleted in a fork with an override, or marked under the bin item of a deletion in a fork'); END

schema.name: versions_failed_error_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_failed_error_update BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON versions WHEN NEW.status = 'failed' AND NEW.purged_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_texts WHERE version_seq = NEW.seq AND error_json IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'failed versions require an error payload'); END

schema.name: versions_flags_frozen
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_flags_frozen BEFORE UPDATE OF starred, hidden ON versions WHEN NEW.starred IS NOT OLD.starred OR NEW.hidden IS NOT OLD.hidden BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version keeps the flags it was inserted with; a fork sets them with an override'); END

schema.name: versions_fork_copy
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_fork_copy BEFORE INSERT ON versions WHEN NEW.fork_id IS NOT NULL AND ((SELECT chat_id FROM forks WHERE id = NEW.fork_id) IS NOT (SELECT chat_id FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM versions o WHERE o.id = NEW.source_version_id AND o.slot_id = NEW.slot_id AND o.fork_id IS NULL)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a fork''s own version is in its chat and stands in for one of its message''s own'); END

schema.name: versions_fork_fixed
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_fork_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF fork_id ON versions WHEN NEW.fork_id IS NOT OLD.fork_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version keeps its fork'); END

schema.name: versions_fts_delete
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_fts_delete BEFORE DELETE ON versions WHEN OLD.status <> 'generating' BEGIN INSERT INTO versions_fts(versions_fts, rowid, content) SELECT 'delete', OLD.seq, content FROM version_texts WHERE version_seq = OLD.seq; END

schema.name: versions_fts_insert
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON version_texts WHEN (SELECT status FROM versions WHERE seq = NEW.version_seq) <> 'generating' BEGIN INSERT INTO versions_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (NEW.version_seq, NEW.content); END

schema.name: versions_fts_status
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_fts_status AFTER UPDATE OF status ON versions WHEN NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status BEGIN INSERT INTO versions_fts(versions_fts, rowid, content) SELECT 'delete', OLD.seq, content FROM version_texts WHERE version_seq = OLD.seq AND OLD.status <> 'generating'; INSERT INTO versions_fts(rowid, content) SELECT NEW.seq, content FROM version_texts WHERE version_seq = NEW.seq AND NEW.status <> 'generating'; END

schema.name: versions_fts_text
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_fts_text AFTER UPDATE OF content ON version_texts WHEN NEW.content IS NOT OLD.content AND (SELECT status FROM versions WHERE seq = NEW.version_seq) <> 'generating' BEGIN INSERT INTO versions_fts(versions_fts, rowid, content) VALUES ('delete', OLD.version_seq, OLD.content); INSERT INTO versions_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (NEW.version_seq, NEW.content); END

schema.name: versions_generation_ends_once
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_generation_ends_once BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON versions WHEN NEW.status = 'generating' AND OLD.status <> 'generating' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version never goes back to generating'); END

schema.name: versions_identity_fixed
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_identity_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF seq, id, slot_id, ordinal, writer, origin ON versions WHEN NEW.seq IS NOT OLD.seq OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.slot_id IS NOT OLD.slot_id OR NEW.ordinal IS NOT OLD.ordinal OR NEW.writer IS NOT OLD.writer OR NEW.origin IS NOT OLD.origin BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version''s identity, slot, writer and origin never change'); END

schema.name: versions_length_derived
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_length_derived BEFORE UPDATE OF content_length ON versions WHEN NEW.content_length IS NOT (SELECT length(content) FROM version_texts WHERE version_seq = NEW.seq) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version length comes from its payload'); END

schema.name: versions_macro_mode_values
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_macro_mode_values BEFORE INSERT ON versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.macro_mode must be one of template, verbatim') WHERE NEW.macro_mode NOT IN ('template', 'verbatim'); END

schema.name: versions_macro_mode_values_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_macro_mode_values_update BEFORE UPDATE OF macro_mode ON versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.macro_mode must be one of template, verbatim') WHERE NEW.macro_mode NOT IN ('template', 'verbatim'); END

schema.name: versions_model_content_frozen
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_model_content_frozen BEFORE UPDATE OF content ON version_texts WHEN NEW.content IS NOT OLD.content AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM versions v WHERE v.seq = OLD.version_seq AND v.writer = 'model' AND v.status <> 'generating' AND NOT (v.purged_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.content = '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM slots s JOIN chats c ON c.id = s.chat_id JOIN bin_items b ON b.user_id = c.owner_user_id AND b.chat_id = c.id WHERE s.id = v.slot_id AND ( (b.id = v.bin_item_id AND b.kind = 'version') OR (b.id = s.bin_item_id AND b.kind IN ('message', 'branch', 'threads')))))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'model-written versions are immutable once generated; create a new version'); END

schema.name: versions_purge_final
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_purge_final BEFORE UPDATE OF purged_at ON versions WHEN OLD.purged_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.purged_at IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a purged version stays purged'); END

schema.name: versions_rollout_id_same_chat
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_rollout_id_same_chat BEFORE INSERT ON versions WHEN NEW.rollout_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT chat_id FROM rollouts WHERE id = NEW.rollout_id) IS NOT (SELECT chat_id FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.rollout_id must be in the same chat'); END

schema.name: versions_rollout_id_same_chat_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_rollout_id_same_chat_update BEFORE UPDATE OF rollout_id, slot_id ON versions WHEN NEW.rollout_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT chat_id FROM rollouts WHERE id = NEW.rollout_id) IS NOT (SELECT chat_id FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.rollout_id must be in the same chat'); END

schema.name: versions_slot_ordinal_unique
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_slot_ordinal_unique BEFORE INSERT ON versions WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM versions WHERE slot_id = NEW.slot_id AND ordinal = NEW.ordinal) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'UNIQUE constraint failed: versions.slot_id, versions.ordinal'); END

schema.name: versions_source_cleared
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_source_cleared AFTER DELETE ON versions BEGIN UPDATE versions SET source_version_id = NULL WHERE source_version_id = OLD.id; END

schema.name: versions_source_fixed
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_source_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF source_version_id ON versions WHEN NEW.source_version_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_version_id IS NOT OLD.source_version_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version''s source never changes'); END

schema.name: versions_source_same_slot
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_source_same_slot BEFORE INSERT ON versions WHEN NEW.source_version_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT slot_id FROM versions WHERE id = NEW.source_version_id) IS NOT NEW.slot_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version''s source must be another version of its slot'); END

schema.name: versions_status_values
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_status_values BEFORE INSERT ON versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.status must be one of generating, complete, stopped, failed, interrupted') WHERE NEW.status NOT IN ('generating', 'complete', 'stopped', 'failed', 'interrupted'); END

schema.name: versions_status_values_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_status_values_update BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.status must be one of generating, complete, stopped, failed, interrupted') WHERE NEW.status NOT IN ('generating', 'complete', 'stopped', 'failed', 'interrupted'); END

schema.name: versions_writer_values
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_writer_values BEFORE INSERT ON versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.writer must be one of human, model') WHERE NEW.writer NOT IN ('human', 'model'); END

schema.name: versions_writer_values_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_writer_values_update BEFORE UPDATE OF writer ON versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.writer must be one of human, model') WHERE NEW.writer NOT IN ('human', 'model'); END

schema.name: workshop_grants_identity
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER workshop_grants_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON workshop_grants BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'grant identity is immutable') WHERE NEW.chat_id <> OLD.chat_id OR NEW.capability <> OLD.capability OR NEW.target <> OLD.target OR NEW.owner_user_id <> OLD.owner_user_id; END

schema.name: workshop_grants_owner
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER workshop_grants_owner BEFORE INSERT ON workshop_grants BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'grant must belong to the workshop owner') WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chats c WHERE c.id = NEW.chat_id AND c.owner_user_id = NEW.owner_user_id ); END

schema.name: card_chat_membership
schema.sql: CREATE VIEW card_chat_membership AS SELECT DISTINCT p.entity_id, s.chat_id FROM version_participants p CROSS JOIN versions v ON v.id = p.version_id CROSS JOIN slots s ON s.id = v.slot_id WHERE v.purged_at IS NULL AND s.purged_at IS NULL

schema.name: version_records
schema.sql: CREATE VIEW version_records AS SELECT v.*, t.cast_json, t.presence_json, t.content, t.context_form, t.display_form, t.reasoning, t.raw_content, t.raw_reasoning, t.raw_sections, t.rewrite_json, t.reply_sections, t.frozen_macros, t.greeting_ref, t.direction, t.error_json, t.usage_json, t.recorded_model_json, t.recorded_generation_json FROM versions v JOIN version_texts t ON t.version_seq = v.seq
